label: adult-s1
resisted: Nothing resisted coverage. A 7-node workclass/occupation subtree (3996) is fully masked by a native-country:22 switch (exactly zero effect on all train rows), described as inert residue. relationship0 indicator practically inert. Unexplained: education:3/4 lower P(<=50K) by ~2 logits. Category names inferred from PMLB alphabetical coding.
tool_bugs: Compositions accept only their own nodes plus child exits as entries. get_formula on root ~10 min; compute_shap (500 vs 500 background) ~36 min under contention. One transient empty get_model_state.
summary: P(income<=50K) = sigmoid(z): essentially logistic regression over 44 direct inputs (married-civ-spouse -3.4 logit, education-num -1.15/SD, male -1.2, wife -1.5) plus one real nonlinearity, a concave piecewise-linear capital-gain penalty (kinks ~3.8k and 4.8k USD); removing it: train acc 0.852 -> 0.824, AUC 0.907 -> 0.888. Other hidden nodes are one-hot indicators; rare categories with standardized values 20-66 act as saturating switches.
